title: Dark mode shows the Inactive tag and Not Tracked; at 375 px the Edit Library Part footer stacks
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: QAPL-I1 (inactive; also stocked at Staging Lethbridge); QAPL-U2 (untracked, 2 bins with quantities); QAPL-B1 (stocked at both locations). Theme: profile menu > Dark. Window 1440 px, then 375 px (DevTools device toolbar).
custom_steps:
1. Profile menu > Dark. Parts > Part Library > open QAPL-I1.
  2. Open QAPL-U2's entry.
  3. Open QAPL-B1's entry > pencil; change the Description and then the Part Number without saving.
  4. With the window still open and both values changed, resize to 375 px.
  5. Close the window with the X (no save), switch the theme back to Light and resize to 1440 px.
custom_expected:
1. On the row of the location where the part is inactive, the grey "Inactive" tag (pill_library_part_inactive_{workplaceId}) shows before the Remaining Quantity value, legible on the dark background.
  2. The untracked row shows "Not Tracked" (text_not_tracked_{workplaceId}) in Remaining Quantity in place of the quantity, legible in dark mode.
  3. "This also changes the description at 1 other location." and "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." show under the fields, legible in dark mode.
  4. The footer stacks full width: Delete above Save. Both hints wrap onto more lines without being clipped.
  5. The window closes without saving (QAPL-B1 unchanged); light mode shows the page as before.
